A PhD at Wageningen University & Research
Funding your PhD
Funding your PhD
Intro
There are two ways to fund your PhD position: apply for an already funded position via a vacancy, or find your own funding.
WGS Sandwich PhD programme
WGS Sandwich PhD programme
Do you have an innovative research idea and would you like to pursue a PhD at Wageningen University & Research? The WGS Sandwich PhD programme might be for you. Apply for a position and receive a grant that covers living allowance for 18 months.
Go to WGS Sandwich programme
AGD programme
AGD programme
The Sino-Dutch Agriculture Green Development (AGD) Programme is a PhD program jointly conducted by Wageningen University & Research (WUR) and China Agricultural University (CAU). It aims for interdisciplinary research on AGD as well as training talented young scientists. This programme makes it possible for outstanding students from China to pursue a PhD degree from WUR or CAU.
Go to AGD programme
WU-CAAS programme
WU-CAAS programme
Wageningen University (WU) and the Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences (CAAS) have a collaborative PhD programme to strengthen their collaboration with joint PhD projects. PhD candidates are supervised by WU and CAAS supervisors and a WU promotor, as the defence is in Wageningen.
More information on CAAS
